newsitem.title: USA: AEP Industries subsidiary buys ICI business.
newsitem.headline: AEP Industries subsidiary buys ICI business.

text.p: AEP Industries Inc said Friday its Australian subsidiary, AEP Industries Pty Ltd, signed an agreement to buy the Visqueen polyethylene plastic film business from ICI Australia Ltd
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
AEP expects the acquisition to be immediately accretive to its earnings.
The company said it expects to complete the deal by the end of July.
The deal includes the plant, equipment, and industrial film business currently conducted at the ICI Films site at Chester Hill, New South Wales.
The Visqueen films operation makes a range of industrial polyethylene films including pallet wrap and shrink wrap primarily for the brewery, soft drink, and glass manufacturing industries.
Visqueen had total sales of about $21 million in 1996.
AEP Australia makes a range of printed, laminated, and converted flexible packaging for the retail paper products, snack, confectionary, and other food markets.
